title: Finance Pro – AI Financial Command Center
summary: AI-powered finance app with natural language expense tracking, real-time dashboards, and smart automation — in Arabic & English.
impact: Enabled natural language financial tracking using AI (Arabic & English).
Centralized income, expenses, investments, and balances into one real-time system.
Automated detection of untracked spending through balance reconciliation.
Delivered a full product experience with secure sandbox mode for public usage.
